Get CEBL Player Statistics

Source: R/cebl.R
cebl_player_stats.Rd

Player statistic table (totals or per game) for a season or all-time; filter by competition, segment or team.

Endpoint: GET https://api.data.cebl.ca/players/statistics/aggregated/

Usage

cebl_player_stats(
  mode = "PER_GAME",
  season = NULL,
  competition = NULL,
  segment = NULL,
  team_id = NULL
)

Arguments

mode

(default "PER_GAME") TOTALS (sums over the selected games) or PER_GAME (per-game averages); the API requires one.

season

(default NULL) Season: the calendar year (May to August) = the sdv END year. NULL = every season combined (the Stats Hub's All-Time). An unknown year answers hoopR_no_data.

competition

(default NULL) REGULAR (regular season) or FINALS (the playoffs). NULL = both.

segment

(default NULL) Game subset: HOME, AWAY, L7D (last 7 days), L5G (last 5 games), L10G (last 10 games), MAY, JUNE, JULY or AUGUST. NULL = all games. Values from the CEBL Stats Hub bundle.

team_id

(default NULL) CEBL team id (team_id in cebl_teams): limits the rows to that team; the rows echo it.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player statistic table (totals or per game) for a season or all-time; filter by competition, segment or team. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py cebl_player_stats):

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason: the calendar year it is played in (May to August) = the sdv END year (2025). Taken from the request (the body does not echo it); null for the all-time table and for a bare body.
modecharacterTable mode of the request: TOTALS (sums over the selected games) or PER_GAME (per-game averages); the body does not echo it.
competitioncharacterCompetition filter of the request: REGULAR or FINALS; null when both were asked. The body does not echo it.
segmentcharacterGame-subset filter of the request (HOME, AWAY, L5G, MAY ...); null for all games. The body does not echo it.
player_idintegerCEBL player id (its own key space). Joins /players/{player_id}/ and id in the other player rows. Genius LiveStats data.json carries no person id, so the join to Genius play-by-play is by name, team and jersey number (unverified).
full_namecharacterPlayer's full name.
nationalitycharacterNationality: an upper-case English country name ('CANADA', 'UNITED STATES', 'SOUTH SUDAN'); null when unknown.
team_idintegerCEBL team id (its own key space; not a Genius id). Joins /teams/ id, the games' home_team_id / away_team_id, team_id in player rows and the team_id / vs_team_id params. A relocated or renamed franchise has a second id: the Stats Hub groups 15+56 (Saskatchewan Rattlers, Saskatoon Mamba), 17+53 (Calgary Surge, Guelph Nighthawks), 19+55 (Brampton, Hamilton Honey Badgers) and 16+54 (Vancouver, Fraser Valley Bandits).
team_name_encharacterFull English name of the player's team.
team_short_name_encharacterShort English name (city) of the player's team.
team_name_frcharacterFull French name of the player's team.
team_short_name_frcharacterShort French name (city) of the player's team.
team_logo_urlcharacterLogo URL (icon with the name) of the player's team.
playedintegerGames played (a count in both modes).
startedintegerGames started (a count in both modes).
minutesdoubleMinutes played, decimal minutes (not mm:ss). TOTALS: the sum ('1281.7'); PER_GAME: the per-game average ('29.5'). A string.
pointsdoublePoints scored. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
field_goals_madedoubleField goals made (2- and 3-pointers). TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
field_goals_attempteddoubleField goals attempted (2- and 3-pointers). TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
field_goal_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the selected games (the same in both modes). A string.
three_points_madedoubleThree-pointers made. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
three_points_attempteddoubleThree-pointers attempted. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
three_point_percentagedoubleThree-point percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the selected games (the same in both modes). A string.
free_throws_madedoubleFree throws made. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
free_throws_attempteddoubleFree throws attempted. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
free_throw_percentagedoubleFree-throw percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the selected games (the same in both modes). A string.
offensive_reboundsdoubleOffensive rebounds. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
defensive_reboundsdoubleDefensive rebounds. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
reboundsdoubleTotal rebounds (offensive + defensive). TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
assistsdoubleAssists. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
turn_oversdoubleTurnovers. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
stealsdoubleSteals. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
blocksdoubleShots blocked. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
foulsdoublePersonal fouls committed. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
double_doublesdoubleDouble-doubles: games with 10 or more in two of points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
triple_doublesdoubleTriple-doubles: games with 10 or more in three of those. TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').
target_scoresdoubleTarget-score baskets: games in which the player made the basket that reached the Elam Ending target score and ended the game (CEBL has used the Elam Ending since 2020, so 2019 is 0). TOTALS: the sum over the selected games; PER_GAME: the per-game average, 1 decimal. A decimal sent as a string ('2256.0', '12.7').

Details

  • CEBL own API, owner-approved gray area: these wrappers read the league's own FastAPI service (api.data.cebl.ca, the backend of the CEBL Stats Hub) with the X-Api-Key that the hub's own page bundle ships to every browser. The key is not issued to third parties and no developer terms were found; cebl.ca's terms of use were not reviewed. The runtime reads the key from the bundle at run time, falls back to a documented constant, never prints it, and raises hoopR_asset_fetch with a 'key rotated?' hint on a persistent 401. www.cebl.ca/robots.txt disallows nothing. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets; requests are spaced at least 1 s apart.

  • Season is the calendar year (May to August) = the sdv END year: no mapping. The first season is 2019. An unknown season, team or player answers an empty list, which the runtime raises as hoopR_no_data. Ids are CEBL's own; a relocated franchise has two team ids (cebl_teams lists all 15).

  • This API has no box-score, play-by-play or shot route. They live in Genius LiveStats (organisation CEBL, see the genius family): cebl_games and cebl_player_gamelog carry the Genius match id as genius_match_id, parsed from the stats URLs (derived, not fetched; the match of a cancelled game may have no data). home_team_id is Genius team 1 and away_team_id team 2 (checked on match 2600563).

  • Some completed schedule rows have null scores (2026), and a cancelled game has status CANELLED (the API's spelling) with null or zero scores. The schedule lists unplayed games too, so no wrapper refuses an unfinished game. Aggregates are decimal strings upstream and double here. Players' names, nationality and birth date are the public bio; no contact data is served.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty list, an all-null profile: an unknown season, team or player), hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a key the API still refuses after one re-read, any other non-200, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, a body for another season, team or player), all inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 500 is the API's answer to a bad id and is not retried. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame.

  • Deliberate divergence: a string column that the API sends as an object, or a list of objects, carries compact JSON here ({"name":"TSN"}), where sdv-py's String cast writes Python's str(dict) repr ({'name': 'TSN'}). No string column of the committed fixtures carries an object.
